index.first_visit_body: Inguqulo emfushane, indlela yokufika yangempela: isimemo somngane, igumbi eliphilayo, ikhaya, umhlaba ophilayo, nephepha lakho lokuvota lokuqala. Imizuzu eyishumi.
index.intro_a: Indlela eyodwa eqondile emhlabeni wonke — izindawo ezi-{stops} ezihambela izenzo ezi-{acts}. Qala phezulu futhi
index.intro_b: ibar hamba phezulu kuyo yonke isikrini, ukuze ukwazi ukuhamba konke okwenzeka futhi uphinde njengoba uya. Gxuma noma kuphi.
index.intro_cite: Ukuhamba okuhleliwe · Buyela emuva / Okulandelayo kuyo yonke isikrini
index.lr_note: Uhambo alukubambi — isikrini ngasinye yikuphepha langempela, okusebenza ngokuphelele, kunebar yeBuyela emuva / Okulandelayo eklanywe phezulu. Shiya uhambo noma nini kusuka kumenyu evamile, noma ubuyele lapha ohlwini olugcwele.
index.pick_step: noma ukhethe isinyathelo sanoma yisiphi ngezansi
index.title: Hamba konke, ngokulandelana
landing.expired_intro: Lelo xhumano alisasebenzi — kodwa isicabha sisivulekile. Noma ubani angajoyina.
landing.honest_browse_body: — yonke indawo emhlabeni, irekhodi yonke, ukhetho lonke, umthetho wonke.
landing.honest_voice_after: futhi usho lapho uhlala khona. Ukuhlala endaweni yona kuphela ukudingeka okukhona.
landing.honest_voice_mid: — ukuze ukhulume irekhodini, uvote, noma umele isihlalo —
landing.honest_watch_body: — zonke izizwa, imihlangano, nokuvota kwenzeka obala. Igumbi lokubuka lihlelele wonke umuntu.
landing.invite_note: Isimemo asinawo amandla — akekho othola ivoti, isihlalo, noma inzuzo ngokukumema. Isicabha nje.
landing.land_note: Noma yikuphi, uzofika lapho leli xhumano likhombisa khona — indawo eyobe iya kuyo isikhumbulekile.
landing.roster_note: Lolu wuhlu lwezilungu. Abasegumbini manje ababonakali size ungene.
landing.space_intro: ligumbi elingaphakathi — bakugcinile isihlalo. Dala i-akhawunti ube ngaphakathi.
login.intro: Ngena irekhodi lakho Lomuntu. Amalungelo akho ahamba nokuhlala kwakho, hhayi kulesi sikhathi.
login.title: Ngena

operator_login.title: Ukungena kophathi
register.errors_body: Kunezinda ezingadinga ukulungiswa ngaphambi kokuba irekhodi lakho Lomuntu lidalwe.
register.intro: Noma ubani angabhalisa — ukuba umuntu yikona kuphela okudingekayo. Amalungelo akho ayingeni; le-akhawunti inikeza irekhodi lokuphathisa kuphela. Ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa kuvuleka kamuva, ngokuzenzakalelayo, lapho ukuhlala kwakho sekukuqinisekiswa.
register.intro_cite: Ukubhalisa kuvulelekile kunoma yimuphi umuntu — amalungelo ayingeni · Art. I
register.lifecycle_gloss: Inhlangano ikhona ngasikhathi sinye kuzo zonke izinga (lokal → Umhlaba); ukuvota nokuba umkhethwa kuvuleka ku-R-03 ngaphandle kwezinye izidingo.
register.name_hint: Sebenzisa igama elifuna ukuba lirekhodi lakho lomphakathi.
register.name_hint_invite: Noma yiliphi igama olilithandayo — ungalishintsha kamuva.
register.reg_cite: kutholakala ku-R-01 Umuntu · idala irekhodi loMuntu · Art. I (amalungelo angingeni)
register.terms: Ngiyayiqonda ukuthi irekhodi lek account yami ngeyami, ukukhomba kwendawo yami kuhleli ukuba kube yimfihlo, futhi izenzo zami zomphakathi ziba yingxenye yirekhodi lomphakathi elingengezwa kuphela.
register.title: Dala i-account yakho
register.tz_hint: Izinsuku zibonakala ngesikhathi sakho sendawo · zigcinwe njenge-UTC.
report.about: Yonke imibiko ingeyenye yezihloko ezintathu, futhi ngayinye iya endaweni eyodwa — abasebenzi, ukusekelwa kokuhumusha, ukulawula nefloor yezomthetho, noma i-product backlog. Ukwamukela kulandisa isicelo; akukaze kuhlele noma kususe okuqukethwe ngokwalo.
report.abuse_note: Imibiko yokuhlukumeza nokuqukethwe okungekho emthethweni iya eqandeni lokulawula neqembu lezomthetho, hhayi emugqeni wokusekelwa. Ukufayila lapha akususi lutho — ukususa okuqukethwe kulandela imithetho yomthethosisekelo (umshini we-F-SOC-003), hhayi leli fomu.
report.body_hint: Amazwi alula ayanele. Faka lokho obikulindele nalokho obukubonile esikhundleni salokho.
report.intro: Bika inkinga — i-bug, umbuzo, noma okuthile okudinga ukubuyekezwa. Uzothola inombolo yokubhekisisa ukuze ukwazi ukulandelela.
report.subject_hint: Isihloko esifushane sisiza ekuhleleni — imininingwane iya phansi.
ticket.route_moderation_text: Lombiko uhamba ngefloor yokulawula neyezomthetho — hhayi emugqeni wokusekelwa kwe-tech. Akususi lutho; ukususa okuqukethwe kulandela imithetho yomthethosisekelo (F-SOC-003).
ticket.triage_note: Ukuhlunga ukushintsha kwirekhodi okuhambisana nomuntu — ikuhambisa futhi iyikulandelela, ayikaze isuse okuqukethwe.
tickets.intro_operator: Yonke imibiko efayilwe kule ndawo, okusebenza okusha kuqala — ulandelelwano lokuhlunga. Imibiko yokusebenzisa kabi okuqukethwe okungemthetho ithunyelwa ekhasini lokulawula nezemthetho futhi ifakwa phandle kwelandelelwano lapha.
tickets.intro_self: Imibiko oyifayilwe nokuthi lowo ngamunye ume kanjani. Ubona eyakho kuphela — ukufayila kuhambisana nomuntu, ukufunda kuyimfihlo yawe.
video_library.about_1: Umsindo nezincazelo zingasebenzisa ulimi olulodwa noma izilimi ezehlukene. Izikhetho zakho ziyikhumbula le browser.
video_library.about_2_before: Ukuze ubuyekeze ukukhuliswa kolimi, vula i-
video_library.count_line: amavidiyo ayi-{n} kuze kube manje. Khetha elilodwa ukuze lilandwe phezulu — ukukhetha kwakho ulimi kuyakulandela.
video_library.intro: Khetha ifilimu nolimi lomsindo nezincazelo oluthandayo.
video_library.sample_banner: Lezi zifilimu ziyizibonelo ezivela kuwebhusayithi we-Cosmopolitan Coalition. Zikhombisa ukuthi umdlali usebenza kanjani: ifilimu eyodwa, echazwe futhi enamazwi olimi amaningi. Amafilimu ohlelo ngokwalo azozithatha indawo yazo.
video_manager.audio_hint: Ifayela elilodwa ngolimi. Ulimi lufundwa egameniC lofayela, noma ulilungise ngezansi.
video_manager.captions_hint: Ifayela elilodwa ngolimi. Ulimi lufundwa egameni lofayela, noma ulilungise ngezansi.
video_manager.demo_note: Ukufaka kwenza amafayela angempela kulayibrari. Alikho isimo sokuzivocavoca lapha; isikhala singesomsebenzi wangempela.
video_manager.error_generic: Ukufaka akukwazanga ukugcinwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
video_manager.intro: Faka ikhophi eyisisekelo ethule yefilimu, umsindo wayo, nezincazelo, bese uabela amafilimu ezindaweni ze-Learning Drawer.
video_manager.master_hint: Kudingeka lapho le sihloko singenayo ikhophi yesisekelo.
video_manager.preview: Ukubuka nje. Ukufaka nokubela amavidiyo kuyithuluzi lomsebenzi ngesikhathi sokuthuthukiswa.
video_manager.subject_hint: Kuzozwakala njengesihloko. Izinhlamvu, izinombolo, izikhala namaphuzu kuphela. Leli igama lefolda ekudiskini.
